answer_md: Two papers evaluate on real field photos. [2, p.5] reports 88.4% top-1 accuracy with a ViT on 12,000 field images, and [4, p.6] reaches 81% five-shot accuracy on tomato and cassava field photos.

sources.snippet: On the held-out field test set, ViT-B/16 achieves 88.4% top-1 accuracy, compared with 82.1% for ResNet-50.
All query images were photographed in farmers' fields under natural lighting; five-shot accuracy reaches 81%.
